topic: A person discovers their child has the same teacher they had
text: I wandered through the paths of the forest, the gentle tread of my paws barely disturbing the carpet of fallen leaves. The air carried the scent of earth and the distant murmur of the river. It was as if the forest itself sighed a quiet, steady breath. Somewhere, a small bird sang a soft melody, its notes threading through the trees. I paused, the sun warming my fur, and for a moment, the world felt slow and steady, the way it always has been, the way it always will be.
